params.label: Pitch
params.help: Base pitch, exponential, 32 steps per octave: 30.5 Hz at 0, 61 Hz at 32, 122 Hz at 64 ... 7.69 kHz at 255 (8 MHz clock)

params.label: Decay
params.help: Main envelope: one step (-1/8, about -1.2 dB; -1 below 8) every 2^decay frames (13 to 15 act as 13). -30 dB after 30 steps: 0.5 ms at 0, 4 ms at 3, 32 ms at 6, 0.25 s at 9, 4 s at 13

params.label: Wave
params.help: 0 triangle, 1 driven (triangle x2, clipped), 2 square, 3 metal (the square XOR fixed squares at fs/2 and fs/8)

params.label: Noise color
params.help: 0 dark (4-sample average), 1 white, 2 bright (first difference), 3 metallic buzz (fixed squares XORed)

params.label: Bend
params.help: Pitch-envelope depth: the pitch starts 0, 1, 2 or 3 octaves higher (offset = aux x bend / 8 steps) and falls with the aux envelope

params.label: Aux time
params.help: Aux envelope speed (bend, short parts, clap). Modes 0-2: one step (-1/8) every 2^(bendtime+3) frames, so it falls to 1/4 in 1.4 ms at 0, 5.6 ms at 2, 11 ms at 3, 23 ms at 4, 45 ms at 5, 90 ms at 6, 180 ms at 7. Mode 3 (clap): it falls by 1 every 2^bendtime frames, so the 3 bursts are 64 x 2^bendtime frames apart (8.2 ms at 3)

params.label: Envelope mode
params.help: 0 tone and noise follow the main envelope; 1 the tone follows min(main, aux) (short body, long noise); 2 the noise follows min(main, aux) (click on a long tone); 3 clap: the noise comes in 3 bursts, then follows the main envelope

params.label: Tone/noise
params.help: Noise share: mix/8 of the output clocks play the noise, the rest the tone; 7 = noise only

params.label: Level
params.help: Start level: the main envelope starts at 17 x level (0 = silent)

params.label: Click
params.help: Start phase: 0 the triangle starts at zero (soft), 1 it starts at its peak (a click at the attack)
